lang.title: Choose your language
lang.subtitle: You can change this anytime in Settings.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Shape.
tour.welcome.body: A quick tour of where everything lives — about 30 seconds.
tour.home.title: Your day, at a glance.
tour.home.body: Your next move, meals and habits — all on the home screen.
tour.train.title: Today’s session.
tour.train.body: Your workout, ready to start — written by your coach, or built by you. Coach optional.
tour.eat.title: Meals & logging.
tour.eat.body: Your plan for the day. Tap a meal to log it in one tap.
tour.grocery.title: Grocery lists.
tour.grocery.body: Your week’s meals become a shopping list, sorted by aisle — auto-built for you.
tour.habits.title: Daily habits.
tour.habits.body: Check off the small things that add up — every one feeds your Shape Score.
tour.chat.title: Coaches & community.
tour.chat.body: Message your coaches and see the community feed.
tour.you.title: Your profile.
tour.you.body: Your living profile — climb, signals and everything you’ve earned.
tour.progress.title: Trends & PRs.
tour.progress.body: Weight, strength, sleep, volume — your whole picture, charted.
tour.goal.title: What you’re shaping toward.
tour.goal.body: Targets, milestones and your ETA — the contract you set with yourself.
tour.score.title: Your Shape Score.
tour.score.body: The one number that tells the truth — earn it, spend it, climb the tiers.
tour.radio.title: Shape Radio.
tour.radio.body: Ad-free workout mixes, curated by BPM. Free with your membership.
score.intro: One number for showing up. Everything you log feeds it — and it climbs as you stay consistent. Here’s the gist.
score.tiers.head: Climb the tiers
score.tiers.body: Earn points to climb — and your tier never goes down once you reach it.
score.earn.head: Ways to earn
score.earn.compoundsBody: — hold your momentum and the weekly bonus grows. Your Score page lists every way to earn.
score.spend.head: Spend what you earn
score.spend.body: Turn points into real rewards — session credit, gear and more — in the Shape Store. Spending never lowers your rank.
score.protect.head: Protect your points
score.protect.body: Stay consistent to keep them. Skip a committed check-in or workout and the number dips a little — a coach can always waive it, and you never drop below 0.
dob.title: Confirm your date of birth.
dob.subtitle: Adults 18 and over
dob.body: Shape is for adults 18 and over, and every account needs a date of birth on file. You’ll only be asked once — the date can’t be changed afterwards, so check it before you save.
dob.label: Date of birth
dob.blockedBody: Your account setup didn’t complete, so there’s nothing to save this to yet. Contact support and we’ll put it right.
dob.genericError: Could not save your date of birth. Try again.
dob.errInvalidDate: Enter a real date of birth.
dob.errUnder18: Shape is for adults 18 and over.
dob.errAlreadySet: Your date of birth is already on file and can’t be changed here. Contact support if it’s wrong.
